# Calculate the average claim amounts for each subgroup
grouped_data = dataset.groupby([''gender'', ''smoker'', ''diabetic''])[''claim''].mean().reset_index()

# Pivot the data to get smoker and diabetic status in the columns, and gender as rows
pivot_data = grouped_data.pivot_table(index=''gender'', columns=[''smoker'', ''diabetic''], values=''claim'')

# Now let''s create the bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

# Get unique categories for smoker and diabetic status
smoker_categories = grouped_data[''smoker''].unique()
diabetic_categories = grouped_data[''diabetic''].unique()

# Define bar positions for each group
bar_positions = np.arange(len(pivot_data.index))
bar_width = 0.2

# Plot each group of bars
for i, smoker in enumerate(smoker_categories):
    for j, diabetic in enumerate(diabetic_categories):
        # Calculate positions for each bar
        positions = bar_positions + (i * len(diabetic_categories) + j) * bar_width
        plt.barh(positions, pivot_data[(smoker, diabetic)], height=bar_width, label=f''{smoker} Smoker, {diabetic} Diabetic'')

# Add labels, title and legend
plt.ylabel(''Gender'', fontsize=25)
plt.yticks(bar_positions + bar_width, pivot_data.index, fontsize=20)
plt.xlabel(''Average Claim Amount'', fontsize=20)
plt.title(''Average Claim Amount by Smoking and Diabetic Status across Genders'', fontsize=25)
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
